BrochureContent.Content:
A rare opportunity to acquire an extended Edwardian red brick end-of-terrace property extending to approximately 197 sq. m. Situated on a prominent corner site of approx. 0.138 acres with extensive side and rear gardens, dual frontage onto Finglas Road and St. Philomena's Road.

Presented in move in condition the property is currently configured to provide five spacious en-suite bedrooms with shared living facilities, together with a generous self-contained two-bedroom apartment, offering an excellent investment opportunity with immediate rental income potential. No 33 could easily be converted back into a magnificent family home. 

The generous site, complemented by two existing garages and a shed, offers further potential for extension or redevelopment, subject to the necessary planning permission.

Ideally located within easy reach of Dublin City Centre, DCU and Dublin Airport. Glasnevin benefits from an excellent range of local amenities and public transport links, making it a very popular and well-established residential area.
